age_minimum.quote: To be eligible to be licensed as a dietitian nutritionist, an applicant shall be at least 18 years of age

moral_character_required.quote: To be eligible to be licensed as a dietitian nutritionist, an applicant shall be at least 18 years of age; be of good moral character

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate, master's, or doctoral degree with a major course of study in human nutrition, foods and nutrition, dietetics, or equivalent (for dietitian nutritionist); master's or doctoral degree in nutrition or clinical health care field (for nutritionist)
degree_required.quote: the applicant has received a baccalaureate, master's or doctoral degree with a major course of study in human nutrition, foods and nutrition, dietetics, food systems management, nutrition education, nutrition, nutrition science, clinical nutrition, applied clinical nutrition, nutrition counseling, nutrition and functional medicine, nutritional biochemistry, nutrition and integrative health, or an equivalent course of study

accrediting_body.value: Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics (ACEND); regional accrediting agency recognized by Council on Higher Education Accreditation and the U.S. Department of Education
accrediting_body.quote: a college or university accredited at the time of graduation from the appropriate regional accrediting agency recognized by the Council on Higher Education Accreditation and the federal Department of Education and that, as approved by the Board, meets the competency requirements of an Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics accredited didactic program in dietetics

degree_level.quote: the applicant has received a baccalaureate, master's or doctoral degree with a major course of study in human nutrition, foods and nutrition, dietetics, food systems management, nutrition education, nutrition, nutrition science, clinical nutrition, applied clinical nutrition, nutrition counseling, nutrition and functional medicine, nutritional biochemistry, nutrition and integrative health, or an equivalent course of study

school_approval_basis.quote: meets the competency requirements of an Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics accredited didactic program in dietetics

credential_pegged.quote: provide evidence of current, valid registration as a registered dietitian nutritionist with the Commission on Dietetic Registration

tiers.quote: the applicant has received a baccalaureate, master's or doctoral degree with a major course of study in human nutrition, foods and nutrition, dietetics, food systems management, nutrition education, nutrition, nutrition science, clinical nutrition, applied clinical nutrition, nutrition counseling, nutrition and functional medicine, nutritional biochemistry, nutrition and integrative health, or an equivalent course of study

the applicant has received a master's or doctoral nutrition degree or, has an academic degree, from a foreign country, that has been validated as equivalent to the masters or doctoral degree conferred by a regionally accredited college or university in the United States

required.quote: the applicant has successfully completed a planned clinical program in an approved practice of dietetics and nutrition that, as approved by the board, meets the competency requirements of an Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics accredited supervised practice experience of not less than 1,200 hours

experience_source.quote: the applicant has successfully completed a planned clinical program in an approved practice of dietetics and nutrition that, as approved by the board, meets the competency requirements of an Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics accredited supervised practice experience of not less than 1,200 hours under the supervision of a dietitian nutritionist licensed in this State

duration.value: not less than 1,200 hours (dietitian nutritionist); not less than 1,000 hours (nutritionist)
duration.quote: supervised practice experience of not less than 1,200 hours under the supervision of a dietitian nutritionist licensed in this State

kind.value: planned clinical program / supervised practice experience
kind.quote: the applicant has successfully completed a planned clinical program in an approved practice of dietetics and nutrition that, as approved by the board, meets the competency requirements of an Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics accredited supervised practice experience

exams.name: Registration Examination for Dietitian Nutritionists (Commission on Dietetic Registration)
exams.notes: Required for licensed dietitian nutritionist pathway (non-CDR-registered applicants). The exam is administered by CDR and held at least twice a year; may be administered by a national testing service.
exams.quote: the applicant has passed the registration examination for dietitian nutritionists administered by the Commission on Dietetic Registration, which shall be held by the board at least twice a year and may be administered by a national testing service, as determined by the board

exams.name: Examination administered by the Board for Certification of Nutrition Specialists or the American Clinical Board of Nutrition
exams.notes: Required for licensed nutritionist pathway (one of two alternative exam criteria).
exams.jurisdiction: national (Board for Certification of Nutrition Specialists or American Clinical Board of Nutrition)
exams.quote: the applicant has successfully passed either the examination administered by the Board for Certification of Nutrition Specialists or the examination administered by the American Clinical Board of Nutrition

interval_years.quote: issue and renew biennial licenses for dietitian nutritionists and nutritionists pursuant to P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.)

required.quote: presentation of satisfactory evidence that the renewal applicant has successfully completed the continuing education requirements prescribed by the board by regulation

available.quote: the board shall license without examination a nutritionist or dietitian who is licensed, registered or certified by another state or possession of the United States or the District of Columbia which has standards substantially equivalent to those of this State

requirements.value: Payment of a fee, submission of written application, and licensure/registration/certification by another state with substantially equivalent standards.
requirements.quote: Upon payment to the board of a fee and the submission of a written application on forms provided by it, the board shall license without examination a nutritionist or dietitian who is licensed, registered or certified by another state or possession of the United States or the District of Columbia which has standards substantially equivalent to those of this State.

exists.quote: There is created in the Division of Consumer Affairs in the Department of Law and Public Safety the State Board of Dietetics and Nutrition.

national_certification.value: Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR); Board for Certification of Nutrition Specialists (BCNS); American Clinical Board of Nutrition (ACBN)
national_certification.quote: provide evidence of current, valid registration as a registered dietitian nutritionist with the Commission on Dietetic Registration

national_association.quote: "Commission on Dietetic Registration" means the credentialing agency of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics.

regulatory_model.quote: A person shall not provide medical nutrition therapy, whether compensated or not, unless the person holds a valid license issued pursuant to P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.) to practice in this State

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a license to any applicant who, in the opinion of the board, has satisfactorily met the requirements specified in section 9 of P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-9).

is_mandatory.quote: A person shall not provide medical nutrition therapy, whether compensated or not, unless the person holds a valid license issued pursuant to P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.) to practice in this State

title_protection.quote: No person, business entity or its employees, agents, or representatives shall use the titles, "dietitian nutritionist," "nutritionist," "dietitian," "dietician," "nutrition counselor," "nutrition specialist," "LDN," "LD," "LN," "nutritional therapy practitioner," "nutritional therapy consultant," "certified nutrition therapy practitioner," "master nutrition therapist," "licensed dietitian nutritionist," "licensed nutritionist" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviations, or insignia indicating one as a provider of medical nutrition therapy or as licensed under P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.), unless licensed to practice dietetics and nutrition under the provisions of P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.).

scope_protection.quote: A person shall not provide medical nutrition therapy, whether compensated or not, unless the person holds a valid license issued pursuant to P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.) to practice in this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a certificate, registration, license, or authorization to sit for an examination through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained a certificate, registration, license or authorization to sit for an examination, as the case may be, through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise, or false pretense.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in gross negligence, gross malpractice, or gross incompetence which damaged or endangered the life, health, welfare, safety, or property of any person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence which damaged or endangered the life, health, welfare, safety or property of any person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice, or incompetence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in professional or occupational misconduct as may be determined by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in professional or occupational misconduct as may be determined by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of, or engaged in acts constituting, any crime or offense that has a direct or substantial relationship to the activity regulated by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of, or engaged in acts constituting, any crime or offense that has a direct or substantial relationship to the activity regulated by the board or is of a nature such that certification, registration or licensure of the person would be inconsistent with the public's health, safety, or welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having authority to engage in the regulated activity revoked or suspended by another state, agency, or authority for consistent reasons.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had his authority to engage in the activity regulated by the board revoked or suspended by any other state, agency or authority for reasons consistent with this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or failing to comply with the provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or failed to comply with the provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging the functions of a licensee consistent with public health, safety, and welfare.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging the functions of a licensee in a manner consistent with the public's health, safety and welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the insurance fraud prevention law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of P.L.1983, c.320 (C.17:33A-1 et seq.) or any insurance fraud prevention law or act of another jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presently engaged in drug or alcohol use that is likely to impair the ability to practice with reasonable skill and safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is presently engaged in drug or alcohol use that is likely to impair the ability to practice the profession or occupation with reasonable skill and safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting an unlicensed person or entity to perform an act for which a license is required, or aiding and abetting an unlicensed person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted an unlicensed person or entity to perform an act for which a license or certificate of registration or certification is required by the board, or aided and abetted an unlicensed person or entity in performing such an act

definition_quote.value: The practice of dietetics and nutrition means the integration and application of scientific principles derived from the study of food, nutrition, biochemistry, metabolism, nutrigenomics, physiology, food management, and from behavioral and social sciences in achieving and maintaining health throughout the life span and in providing nutrition care services, including medical nutrition therapy, for the prevention, management, and treatment of disease.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of dietetics and nutrition" means the integration and application of scientific principles derived from the study of food, nutrition, biochemistry, metabolism, nutrigenomics, physiology, food management, and from behavioral and social sciences in achieving and maintaining health throughout the life span and in providing nutrition care services, including medical nutrition therapy, for the prevention, management, and treatment of disease.

value: monitoring and evaluation of nutrition care plans
nutrition support including ordering of parenteral and enteral nutrition
dietary and nutritional counseling and education
development and administration of nutrition care standards and systems
ordering laboratory tests to check and track nutrition status
methods_authorized.quote: This term includes, but is not limited to, nutrition assessment; nutrition diagnosis; nutrition intervention; monitoring and evaluation of nutrition care plans; nutrition support, including the ordering of parenteral and enteral nutrition; dietary and nutritional counseling and education, including regarding food, nutrient and prescription drug interactions; and the development and administration of nutrition care standards and systems.

license_type_structure.quote: "Licensed dietitian nutritionist" means a person who is licensed as a licensed dietitian nutritionist pursuant to the provisions of P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.). "Licensed nutritionist" means a person who is licensed as a licensed nutritionist pursuant to the provisions of P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.).

provisional_license_available.quote: the board shall issue a temporary license to a person who has applied for licensure pursuant to P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.) and who, in the judgment of the board, is eligible for examination.

provisional_license_requires_supervision.quote: the applicant may practice only under the supervision of a supervisor specified in section 9 of P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-9), consistent with State law.

dietetic_technician_recognized.quote: prohibit a nutrition and dietetic technician from providing nutrition services under the supervision of a licensed dietitian nutritionist or licensed nutritionist

rd_credential_accepted_in_lieu_of_state_.quote: provide evidence of current, valid registration as a registered dietitian nutritionist with the Commission on Dietetic Registration

value: Certified Nutrition Specialist (Board for Certification of Nutrition Specialists)
Diplomate of the American Clinical Board of Nutrition (DACBN)
alternative_credential_pathways.quote: the applicant has either a valid current certification with the Board for Certification of Nutrition Specialists that gives the applicant the right to use the term "Certified Nutrition Specialist" or "CNS" or a valid current certification with the American Clinical Board of Nutrition that gives the applicant the right to use the term "Diplomate, American Clinical Board of Nutrition" or "DACBN."

medical_nutrition_therapy_authorized.quote: "Medical nutrition therapy" means the provision of nutrition care services for the intended purpose of treatment or management of a diagnosed disease or medical condition.

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: Enteral and parenteral nutrition therapy consist of specialized enteral or intravenous solutions and shall only be ordered by an individual licensed under P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.) who also meets one of the following criteria

diet_order_writing_authority.quote: A licensed dietitian nutritionist or licensed nutritionist may order patient diets, including therapeutic diets, in accordance with the provisions of P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.).

lab_test_ordering_authority.quote: ordering laboratory tests to check and track nutrition status and monitor effectiveness of dietary plans and orders

diagnosis_treatment_prohibition.quote: The practice of dietetics and nutrition does not include the medical differential diagnosis of the health status of an individual.

value: persons licensed to practice pursuant to Title 45 of the Revised Statutes (within their own scope)
students, trainees, or individuals working under supervision of an authorized provider to fulfill experience or course of study requirements
persons employed by a federal government department, agency, bureau, or unit, Armed Forces, or State institution
persons providing general nutrition information, food guidance, or dietary supplement information without holding out as a licensed dietitian nutritionist or licensed nutritionist
persons providing medical weight control through a program approved by a licensed dietitian nutritionist, registered dietitian, or authorized health care provider
nutrition and dietetic technicians (under supervision of licensed dietitian nutritionist or licensed nutritionist)
individuals under direct supervision of a NJ state licensed health care provider authorized to provide nutrition care services for treatment or management of disease
individuals providing non-medical nutrition therapy nutrition care services who do not hold out as licensed
exempt_professions_list.quote: nothing in P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.) shall be construed to: (1) prohibit a person licensed to practice pursuant to Title 45 of the Revised Statutes from engaging in the practice or teaching of dietetics and nutrition within the scope of that person's license

federal_employee_exemption.quote: prohibit any person from practicing dietetics and nutrition within the scope of the person's official duties when employed by a department, agency, bureau, division, or other unit of the federal government, serving in the Armed Forces of the United States, or employed by any State institution or facility

weight_control_program_exemption.quote: prohibit any person providing medical weight control from doing so through a program of instruction that has been approved in writing by a licensed dietitian nutritionist or licensed nutritionist in this State

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: prohibit any person who does not hold himself or herself out to be a licensed dietitian nutritionist or licensed nutritionist from furnishing nutrition information, providing evaluation, guidance, information, and education as to the use of food, food materials, or dietary supplements

nonresident_temporary_practice_allowed.quote: the board may issue without examination a temporary license authorizing one to provide medical nutrition therapy and to hold oneself out as a dietitian nutritionist or nutritionist in this State to a person who provides evidence that the person is in the State on a temporary basis to assist in a medical emergency or engage in a special project or teaching assignment relating to the practice of dietetics and nutrition

protected_titles.quote: No person, business entity or its employees, agents, or representatives shall use the titles, "dietitian nutritionist," "nutritionist," "dietitian," "dietician," "nutrition counselor," "nutrition specialist," "LDN," "LD," "LN," "nutritional therapy practitioner," "nutritional therapy consultant," "certified nutrition therapy practitioner," "master nutrition therapist," "licensed dietitian nutritionist," "licensed nutritionist" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviations, or insignia indicating one as a provider of medical nutrition therapy or as licensed under P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.), unless licensed to practice dietetics and nutrition under the provisions of P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.).

nutrition_assessment_includes_biochemica.quote: assessing and evaluating the nutritional needs of individuals and groups, and determining resources and constraints in the practice setting, including ordering laboratory tests to check and track nutrition status and monitor effectiveness of dietary plans and orders

inactive_license_status_available.quote: A renewal applicant electing to renew as inactive shall not engage in professional or occupational practice within the State or hold himself out as eligible to engage in professional or occupational practice within the State.
